The decisive error was Polish_TV_Series_Expert's identification at Step 2. Without searching, it claimed Bartosz Opania voiced Ray in "Wszyscy kochają Romana." The correct actor is Wojciech Malajkat, who played Ray in the Polish-language version and appeared in "Magda M." as Wojciech. That wrong premise led to the incorrect answer "Piotr," which the Verification_Expert then approved without actually checking.
